Microsoft AI Data Centre Faces Lawsuit Over Noise Complaints

Microsoft's new AI data center in Wisconsin is facing a class-action lawsuit from neighboring residents. The lawsuit alleges that the facility's generators and HVAC systems produce continuous, excessive noise, described as similar to a freight train, impacting property values. Microsoft claims it has taken steps to address the noise and is committed to being a good neighbor.
